During playtesting, when asked, Christopher stated that the intent was for the Sentinels to be one set or the other, but there wasn't going to be any rule or anything, it is officially okay to do, but not the original intent.  If that matters to you.

Personally I would say promo Mainstay, Idealist, Writhe, original Medico is the best.  Medico healing other heroes that Idealist can now protect, while Writhe's higher hp works with his signature and Mainstay is awesome making damage irreducible while dealing damage.  One of my favorite base powers.

I would expect promo Scrapper to be less friendly to mix and match, but you never know with Christopher.
